pr_summary: Fix misleading performance metrics in Parquet Arrow benchmark suite. The benchmark incorrectly reports identical items_per_second and bytes_per_second values, and calculates byte rate for boolean columns as if each value occupies a full byte instead of using bit-packing. The fix introduces a BytesForItems template function that correctly calculates bytes based on actual storage size: bit-packing for booleans via bit_util::BytesForBits, 2 bytes for Float16, and sizeof(c_type) for fixed-width types. The fix also separates items processed from bytes processed in SetBytesProcessed.
candidate_build_commands: conda install -c conda-forge benchmark boost-cpp cmake ninja

ci/scripts/cpp_build.sh - bash script for Linux/Unix builds

notes: Apache Arrow is a multi-language project with C++ as the core implementation. The fix targets the Parquet Arrow benchmark suite in C++. The project uses CMake for building C++ code and conda for dependency management. Benchmarks use Google Benchmark framework. The archery Python tool in dev/archery provides benchmark orchestration and comparison utilities. The fix modifies how bytes_per_second and items_per_second are calculated to accurately reflect bit-packing for booleans and proper byte counts for different data types. Platform is Linux-compatible; CI runs on Ubuntu with Docker.
